whoItsFor: Developers using Claude Code who want a structured, multi-agent team to plan and build a game, from brainstorming through release. The README describes it as a template you clone to start your own project.
useCases: Structure a solo game project with design docs, sprints, and QA gates
Run specialized agents for design, programming, art, audio, and narrative within one Claude Code session
Coordinate multi-agent workflows for combat, UI, release, and live-ops work

requirements.runtime: Git, Claude Code, Python 3, Bash (jq recommended)
